description:
In what some are speculating could be his final NHL season, Marc-Andre Fleury had the opportunity to play in front of a large gathering of friends and family in Montreal, a city near his hometown of Sorel, QC. This trip to Montreal marked the only visit the Minnesota Wild would make this season. In a truly spectacular fashion, Fleury delivered a remarkable performance for the crowd, making several incredible saves on his way to a 5-2 victory. In the first period, after a Wild turnover, Fleury shut down Josh Anderson's attempt right in front of the crease. As the second period was drawing to a close, with less than five seconds remaining, Fleury showcased his skills with two incredible saves. The first was denying Brendan Gallagher's shot right in the slot, and then he followed it up with a pad save on Josh Anderson's rebound attempt. To top it off, in the early moments of the third period, Fleury made an acrobatic save using a two-pad stack to thwart Johnathan Kovacevic's scoring attempt. Following the game, Fleury was greeted with admiration and cheers from the Montreal crowd.
